title: Hydra Heli 2
description:
Hydra Heli 2 is a direct sequel to Hydra Heli. After the events of the first game, a new threat to Rotondra has appeared, the Island Legion. Control and Master mutiple experimental Hydra Helicopters to destroy this new threat to the nation!

Direct various weapons to destroy battleships and earn shards.

Spend Shards to boost damage, increase firepower, and unlock new regions.

Can you find a way to protect your country from the Island Legion?

FEATURES• Satisfying incremental progression

• A relaxing ~5 hour experience 

• 2 Helicopters to master

• 3 Bosses to defeat

• 9 Regions to discover
description_short: Hydra Heli 2 is a relaxing incremental game about sinking battleships with an overpowered helicopter. Command swarms of unstoppable weapons, annihilate armadas, collect shards, and utilize the Depot to boost damage, increase firepower, and unlock new regions.
